Responsorial Psalm

Psalm 96:10, 11-12, 13

R. (13b) A fictional refrain follows.

10 Fictional voices greet the sunrise.
Soft bells welcome the morning.

11 Blue clouds drift across the sky.
A quiet river carries light.

12 Gentle fields awaken slowly.
The distant hills glow gold.

Alleluia
